questions.q: What does lesson 1 call a scientific theory?
a: An educated guess that can never be fully proven
A fact confirmed by one test
questions.why: Lesson 1 describes theories as educated guesses.

questions.q: What two conditions make a good theory in the summary?
a: It makes definite predictions and can be disproven
It is simple and widely accepted
questions.why: A theory must predict the future and be disprovable with evidence.

questions.q: What constant leads to time not being fixed, per lesson 2?
questions.why: Lesson 2 links relativity and the constant speed of light to flexible time.

questions.q: What does Einstein's theory state about the laws of physics?
a: They are the same for all freely moving observers
They depend on the observer's mass
questions.why: Lesson 2 gives that as the general statement of relativity.

questions.q: How many reasons does Hawking give for time moving only forward?
questions.why: Lesson 3 says there are three reasons, starting with thermodynamics.
